metadata.name: lottery_hook
metadata.description: Bordrless lottery hook: a game coin's token hook under the game ticket standard. Every holder's tokens are their tickets for the round, kept as a range in each holding's hook data; the Bordrless companion draws a verifiable winner and pays the pot. The hook never refuses a transfer, takes no cut and never sees SOL.

docs: Instructions of the lottery hook.

instructions.name: before_burn
docs: `before_burn`: the header rolled and the burner's tickets cut to what it has left, as for a
send.

instructions.name: before_transfer
docs: `before_transfer`: the header rolled, the sender's tickets cut to what it has left, the
receiver's range of the round opened at its first write (for what it held before); each
answered as the holding's hook data when its owner may hold tickets. Never refuses a
transfer, never takes a cut.

instructions.name: enter
docs: Anyone, for any holding of the mint: registers its whole balance for the current round when
it has not been written this round (`bordrless_game::on_enter`). Does nothing for a holding
written this round already, or empty (so nobody can grief a holder by entering it again),
and refuses a holding whose owner can't hold tickets.

accounts.name: mint
docs: must be this program.

accounts.name: holding
docs: `mint`; the token program writes its hook data.

instructions.name: prepare
docs: Prepares the hook for `mint`, which need not exist yet (a launch's mint: the launchpad
creates it naming this program as its hook): the state, with the standard's header and
rounds of `round_secs`, and the extra-accounts registry. The mint's keypair signs, so only
whoever launches it chooses its rounds; once per mint.

accounts.name: payer
docs: Pays the rent.

accounts.name: mint
docs: The mint the hook is prepared for (not created yet); its keypair signs.

errors.name: WrongAccount
errors.msg: an account is not the one this mint's hook expects

errors.name: BadHookSigner
errors.msg: the hook signer is not the token program's signer for this hook

errors.name: BadRoundSecs
errors.msg: a round lasts from an hour to 30 days

errors.name: NotThisHook
errors.msg: this mint's hook is not the lottery hook, writing hook data

errors.name: WrongMint
errors.msg: the holding is of another mint

errors.name: NotEligible
errors.msg: this owner can't hold tickets: the launch, its pool, the companion's creator address, or an address off the ed25519 curve

types.name: Delta
docs: One cut an answer takes from the amount.

fields.name: amount
docs: How much (above zero).

fields.name: account
docs: Index in the callback's account list (prefix first, then extras) of the holding that
receives it. Must be an extra.

types.name: Entered
docs: A holding was entered for the round: its range now, and the round's total.

types.name: GameHeader
docs: The header at the start of a game hook's state ([`header_offsets`]). A hook declares it as the
first field of its state account; the companion reads it from raw bytes ([`GameHeader::parse`]).

fields.name: magic
docs: [`MAGIC`].

fields.name: mint
docs: The game's mint.

fields.name: round_secs
docs: Seconds per round, within [`MIN_ROUND_SECS`] and [`MAX_ROUND_SECS`].

fields.name: round
docs: The round of the last write.

fields.name: total
docs: That round's ticket total: every range of the round lies in `[0, total)`.

fields.name: prev_round
docs: The round the header held before its last roll (the last earlier round with a write, or the
round the hook was prepared in); 0 until the first roll.

fields.name: prev_total
docs: That round's ticket total.

fields.name: last_buyer
docs: The owner of the last qualifying buy (jackpot games; the default key when unused).

fields.name: last_amount
docs: The tokens of the last qualifying buy.

fields.name: last_buy_at
docs: When it was made (0 when unused).

types.name: HookReturn
docs: What a callback may answer in its return data. Which fields a callback may fill depends on the
callback and the flags ([`Allowed`]); the calling program refuses an answer that fills any
other field.

fields.name: deltas
docs: Cuts from the amount (the transfer; a swap's input before, its output after), at most
[`MAX_DELTAS`].

fields.name: burn
docs: Pool swap callbacks only: an amount to burn from the same side.

fields.name: lp_fee_bps
docs: `before_swap` only: the LP fee to apply instead of the pool's.

fields.name: source_hook_data
docs: Token callbacks only (`before_transfer`, `before_burn`): the source holding's new hook data
([`HOOK_DATA_LEN`] bytes).

fields.name: destination_hook_data
docs: Token callbacks only (`before_transfer`, `before_mint`): the destination holding's new hook
data.

types.name: LotteryState
docs: The hook's state for one mint, at `["state", mint]`: the game ticket standard's header first
(the companion reads it at the standard's offsets), then the hook's own fields.

fields.name: header
docs: The standard's header: rounds, the current and previous rounds' ticket totals. The jackpot
fields (`last_buyer`, `last_amount`, `last_buy_at`) stay zero: this hook runs no jackpot.

fields.name: version
docs: Layout version.

fields.name: bump
docs: Bump of `["state", mint]`.

fields.name: launch
docs: The launch program's `["launch", mint]`: never holds tickets.

fields.name: pool
docs: The launch pool, once read from the launch account (default until then): never holds
tickets.

fields.name: creator
docs: The companion's `["creator", mint]`: never holds tickets.

fields.name: prepared_by
docs: Who paid for `prepare`.

fields.name: prepared_at
docs: When.

fields.name: reserved
docs: Reserved.

types.name: Phase
docs: Before or after the operation.

types.name: Prepared
docs: The hook was prepared for a mint.

fields.name: round
docs: The round it was prepared in.

fields.name: creator
docs: The companion's creator address for the mint.

types.name: TokenHookArgs
docs: Arguments of a token hook callback. Balances and hook data are those of the holdings before
(`Before`) or after (`After`) the operation; `delta` is what the deltas took, known only after.

fields.name: op
docs: The operation.

fields.name: phase
docs: Before or after it.

fields.name: mint
docs: The mint.

fields.name: source
docs: Source holding (the mint for a mint).

fields.name: destination
docs: Destination holding (the mint for a burn).

fields.name: source_owner
docs: Owner of the source holding (default for a mint).

fields.name: destination_owner
docs: Owner of the destination holding (default for a burn).

fields.name: authority
docs: Who signed.

fields.name: authority_is_delegate
docs: Whether the signer acted as a delegate rather than the owner.

fields.name: amount
docs: The amount of the operation.

fields.name: delta
docs: The sum of the deltas a `before_transfer` answer took (zero before).

fields.name: source_balance
docs: Source balance.

fields.name: destination_balance
docs: Destination balance.

fields.name: decimals
docs: Decimals of the mint.

fields.name: supply
docs: Supply of the mint.

fields.name: source_hook_data
docs: The source holding's hook data (zeros for a mint).

fields.name: destination_hook_data
docs: The destination holding's hook data (zeros for a burn).

types.name: TokenOp
docs: What a token hook is being told about.
